game.name: Bomber Mole
game.desc: A mole with a miner's helmet and a pocket full of bombs digs through meadows on three depths at once: the grass surface and two undergrounds. Collect every golden grub to open the exit molehill, while ferrets hunt you in the tunnels and cats prowl the grass. Four seasons of levels, each with its own weather, hazards and boss.

game.name: Leady Squid
game.desc: A grumpy little squid put on far too many lead diving weights and sinks like a stone. Every tap shoots a jet of water that sends it back up for a moment: swim through the gaps between kelp, coral, ship masts and anchor chains for as long as you can. One button, instant retry, a best score to beat, and a race for up to four players.

game.name: Duck Parade
game.desc: Guide a family of ducks through ponds, roads and rivers. Up to four parents cooperate to bring the ducklings home.

game.name: Blueberry Tumble
game.desc: Roll a blueberry down a changing mountain landscape. Dodge obstacles, collect dew and race with up to four players.

game.name: Beaver Rush
game.desc: Chop trees, dodge hazards and build your score. A fast arcade challenge for one player or a race for up to four.

game.name: Pancake Tower
game.desc: Stack falling pancakes as precisely as possible, from the kitchen to outer space. Build the tallest tower in solo play or compete with up to four chefs.

game.name: Pogo Mamie
game.desc: Bounce across the rooftops of Paris on a pogo stick. Avoid aerial hazards, stomp pigeons and race with up to four grannies.

game.name: Biscuit Bandit
game.desc: A raccoon raids a bakery: catch the cookies falling from the belts on your tray, but never the cups, and carry the stack to the basket. Up to four players.

game.name: Crab Coconut
game.desc: A crab on the beach bounces a coconut off its claws to break the shells that rain from the sky. Up to four players.

game.name: Frog Reach
game.desc: Hold to stretch the frog's tongue just far enough to catch the flies and cross the swamp from lily pad to lily pad. Up to four players.

game.name: Hedgehog Hills
game.desc: Curl up downhill, let go uphill: a hedgehog rolls and flies over endless woodland hills. Up to four players.

game.name: Mole Marbles
game.desc: A miner mole splits the bouncing gemstones of a cave with its harpoon before they crush it. Up to four players.

game.name: Moth Around
game.desc: A moth circles a lantern at night: turn one way or the other to slip through the closing rings. Up to four players.

game.name: Mouse Espresso
game.desc: A mouse wearing an espresso machine flies through the cafe on bursts of steam, collecting biscuits. Up to four players.

game.name: Nutty Branch
game.desc: A squirrel runs along an endless branch: steer, jump the gaps and dodge the traps without sliding off its sides. Up to four players.

game.name: Otter Rapids
game.desc: An otter paddles down the river, catching golden fish and dodging rocks, logs and the shadow of a hungry pike. Up to four players.

game.name: Penguin Slalom
game.desc: A penguin skis between the flags down an endless snowy slope, catching fish and dodging polar bears. Up to four players.

game.name: Radish Rascals
game.desc: A farmer shoos the rabbits from the vegetable beds with a pitchfork, but must spare the hedgehogs. Up to four players.

game.name: Raccoon Recycler
game.desc: A raccoon sorts the toys sliding down the chutes by kind or by colour, while the rules keep changing. Up to four players.

game.name: Snail Switch
game.desc: A snail flips above or below the vine to dodge thorns and caterpillars and reach the fruits. Up to four players.

game.name: Spider Swing
game.desc: A spider swings from flower to flower on its silk and climbs ever higher. Up to four players.

game.name: Unicorn Hop
game.desc: A unicorn hops from cloud to cloud, straight up through a sky of drifting clouds: one tap, at the right moment. Up to four players.

game.name: Cosmo Corgi
game.desc: A corgi astronaut flies its little rocket through space, and space is full of wind-up robots: the rocket barks star shots by itself, you just fly it. Up to four players.

game.name: Fishy Feast
game.desc: A little fish in a big pond: nibble plankton to grow, swallow any fish smaller than you and keep away from the bigger ones. Up to four players.

game.name: Hamster Havoc
game.desc: A hamster in a little glass-dome spaceship defends its cheese moon from waves of marching space mice. Up to four players.

game.name: Caterpillar Crawl
game.desc: A round green caterpillar crawls around a garden bed munching leaves: each leaf makes it longer, so mind the walls, the stones and your own tail. With friends, everyone grows as they crawl and the last one still crawling wins the round. Up to four players.

game.name: Gecko Golf
game.desc: A little gecko in a white visor plays golf on a course that never ends, one hole per screen, over meadows, dunes, snowy hills and a candy land. Aim, hold A to charge, let go: holes in one give strokes back. Up to four players.

game.name: Gopher Dig
game.desc: A gopher in a little yellow hard hat drills straight down a well of jelly-soft blocks: dig out what holds them up and they come tumbling down. Dodge them, grab the air bubbles, and see how deep you can dig. Up to four players.

game.name: Jelly Jam
game.desc: A falling-pairs puzzle duel in a jam kitchen: put four jellies of a colour together and they melt, chains rain grey jellies into your opponent's jar. Duel the kitchen's chefs alone, or play everyone against everyone. Up to four players.

game.name: Kitty Kibble
game.desc: A hungry kitten eats every kibble of a room while four robot vacuums try to tidy it up. A ball of yarn turns the tables for a few seconds. Up to four players.

game.name: Ladybug Laps
game.desc: Tiny ladybugs race round the garden table and through the garden, seen from above: round teacups and sugar cubes, across spilt jam and over a spoon with a hop of their wings. With friends, the screen follows the leader. Up to four players.

game.name: Llama Drama
game.desc: A llama stands in an Andean meadow, and the hornets are coming: turn the long neck and spit to pop them before they sting its nose, from the morning to a starry night. Up to four players.

game.name: Seal Shove
game.desc: Four round seals in woolly caps on a cracking ice floe, and only one may stay: belly-slide into the others and shove them into the sea. The first to 3 rounds wins the match. Up to four players.

game.name: Snowball Siege
game.desc: A snowball fight between snow forts, turn by turn: aim, charge and lob snowballs over the hills, with the wind changing every turn. Every splat carves the snow. Up to four players.
